name: soft-door-box
task: Open the door, then, if possible, pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(door_open) is hard and is the only hard goal, so it is required and is not redundant. Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) is hard, which keeps the stated order: the "if possible" cue scopes only the box pickup, not the "then" that leads into it. The soft Existence(target_picked_up) correctly carries the preference. The compiled machine matches: the box before the door is a hard break to the well, and opening the door reaches the final state.

texts: Open the door (the agent must make door_open true at some point).
The box pickup comes after the door is opened: target_picked_up may happen only once door_open has happened.
If possible, pick up the mission's box in the other room (target_picked_up should happen at some point).
